{{Quote|The Battle of Ord Radama was not lost on the ground. Venemal and I could have held the capital city indefinitely, armed with only our lightsabers. But in orbit, we had only the dreadnaught Lindworm and two Harrower battle cruisers.|Darth Malgus|<ref name="Book of Sith" />}}
The '''''Lindworm''''' was a [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] that was used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. At some point during the conflict, the ''Lindworm'' and two Sith [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts]] assisted with a Sith [[Battle of Ord Radama|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]] that was led by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]]. However, several weeks into the campaign, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sent a force of [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruisers]] and [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]] to the [[Star system/Legends|system]], to drive the Sith off of the world. Moments after their arrival in the system, the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] opened fire on the ''Lindworm'' with their [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]], before the dreadnaught had a chance to launch any [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />

Malgus decided to take command of the ''Lindworm'', and he traveled up to the vessel from the planet surface, in his personal [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. However, by the time that Malgus reached the dreadnaught's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], it was too late for him to change the outcome of the battle, and he observed as one of the ''Harrowers'' plummeted into the atmosphere of Ord Radama and crashed into the planet's [[Livien Magnus|capital city]]. Malgus screamed out in anger, and the force of his rage buckled the bridge's [[Viewport/Legends|viewport]] and caused the crew's ears to [[Blood/Legends|bleed]]. Malgus then ordered the ''Lindworm''{{'s}} navigator to take the ship out of the system and depart for the heart of [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Space]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Lindworm'' was created by [[Daniel Wallace]] and featured in the [[2012]] publication ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''.<ref name="Book of Sith" /> Wallace intended the ship to be a reference to the [[Wikipedia:Lindworm|Lindworm]], a type of mythological creature from [[Wikipedia:Scandinavia|Scandinavian]] folklore.<ref name="Book of Sith endnotes">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2012/03/endnotes-for-star-wars-book-of-sith_15.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: Book of Sith (part 2)}}</ref>
